unit: price-level wave, no candle shape/RSI/volume rules
range: previous20 CLOSED minute closes; freeze at breakout
confirmation: two consecutive closes beyond frozen range edge; signal only second close
state: one active wave until close crosses frozen range midpoint; same direction blocked until opposite confirmed or new segment
evaluation: future CLOSED prices only until structural break or session end; extension2ATR diagnostic, no five-minute constraint and no old1ATR stop
censoring: session/gap/end before extension is unresolved, never silently deleted
sample: 12 consumed SPX sessions; chronological earlier7/later5 descriptive only
